meta.title: Recreate with Event End Time Duration 4 Hrs
gaps: Verify the recreated event has a new RFX/stage code.
Verify the product and delivery location are identical to the closed RFQ.
Verify the recreated event has exactly the same participants as the old event.
Verify Bidding Ends At equals the new start time plus exactly 240 minutes.
Verify the old event remains unchanged.
Verify the recreated event is live immediately with an explicit live status.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the recreated event has a new RFX/stage code.; Verify the product and delivery location are identical to the closed RFQ.; Verify the recreated event has exactly the same participants as the old event.; Verify Bidding Ends At equals the new start time plus exactly 240 minutes.; Verify the old event remains unchanged.; Verify the recreated event is live immediately with an explicit live status.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's project summary as required for this state.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the event settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order pop-up opened.
Verify the recreation dialog contains the product sheet section.
Verify the recreation dialog contains the auction configuration section.
Verify the recreation dialog contains the delivery date field.
Verify the scheduling control is present.
Verify that the required 4-hour end-time duration is offered.
Set the recreated event's end-time duration to 4 hours.
Keep the evaluation duration at 30 minutes.
Verify the evaluation duration remains 30 minutes.
Ensure the recreated event is not scheduled for later.
Verify that the newly recreated event opened successfully.
Verify that recreation completed without an application error.
